newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Bratislava bourse moves higher on blue chip gains.
newsitem.headline: Bratislava bourse moves higher on blue chip gains.

text.p: 1525 GMT - Slovak blue chips close higher in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
* VSZ up five crowns at 685, VUB bank up 10 at 1,760 crowns, Slovnaft up nine at 865, Nafta up five at 1,700.
* Overall volume 443,974 shares, turnover 737.53 million crowns.
